The transparent pocket on the white bib contains a card/image that seems geometrically inconsistent. The edges of the pocket do not cast realistic shadows or refractions on the card inside, making the depth relationship ambiguous and slightly 'flat' or melted.

The pink trim around the neck hole varies inconsistently in width and sharpness, appearing to merge slightly with the main fabric in the lower-left curve, lacking the crisp separation of real sewn piping.
